text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool GPU capacity exhausted (pool: dedicated-acme-01) for tenant acme-corp. 99th latency > 10s, enqueue depth rising. Paging oncall team. severity=P1 :rotating_light:

oncall-robin: on it. joining bridge. any ETA for autoscale?

sre-jamal: we see all 8 GPUs at 100% and >120 waiting requests. Autoscaler failing to add nodes — hitting quota in aws-account-redwood-dedicated (EC2 limit). logs attached.

eng-runtime-max: interesting — the runtime is spiking KV cache churn too. requests are piling because model variant fallback not configured for this tenant (pinned to large-quantized-xl).

infra-kate: confirmed, account quota prevents launching p4d instances in us-west-2. We could request burst but that takes 10-15m.

oncall-robin: immediate mitigation options? list them and call customer if needed.

eng-runtime-max: short list: 1) evict non-critical background jobs for acme-corp (batch evals) 2) temporarily lower model to a smaller variant (pinned model 1.4 -> 1.3) 3) route a % of traffic to hosted fallback (not in their VPC; need customer approval for data flow) 4) auto-scale to other region (cross-region routing) 5) throttle / shed best-effort traffic (graceful 503s)

sre-jamal: +1 to evicting background jobs first. I can push eviction rules now. That frees ~2 GPUs equivalent.

infra-kate: we can also start expedited quota increase (AWS support) but it's not instant.

oncall-robin: cs-amy, please loop in Acme CSM and ask permission for fallback routing to hosted for emergency (data flow implications). Mark as emergency only.

cs-amy: pinged acme-corp CSM (on-call) — they are online, asking for impact details. forwarding their reply here: "we cannot allow data to leave our VPC unless encrypted and logged; temporary outbound to hosted is allowed under emergency with signed waiver"

vp-ops-lena: decision: do not automatically move data out of VPC without signed waiver. pursue eviction + model downgrade + throttling first. start quota request in parallel.

eng-runtime-max: implementing model downgrade path now: create canary route for 10% traffic to model-small-quant (same checkpoints but lower perf). will update route config:

```json
{
  "route": "dedicated-acme-01",
  "canary": 0.1,
  "from_model": "acme-large-quant-xl",
  "to_model": "acme-large-quant-l"
}
```

sre-jamal: eviction applied: killed batch-eval jobs tagged "acme-background". freed ~1.8 GPU equiv. queue depth dropped 22%.

oncall-robin: rolling canary now. watch for regressions. set 5m windows.

incident-bot: deploy job started by eng-runtime-max at 1819000215. status=running.

eng-runtime-max: canary live at 10%. latency improved slightly but throughput still saturated. increasing to 25% for 10m to assess.

vp-ops-lena: note — must capture evaluation logs and perf deltas for later RCA and customer report.

infra-kate: quota request submitted (case 0123456789 to AWS). marked URGENT. in chat with AWS rep.

cs-amy: acme-corp CSM replied: "we accept downgrade to smaller variant for up to 30 minutes; no egress allowed. Please keep us updated every 10 minutes"

oncall-robin: copy. we'll avoid hosted fallback. next step: if canary at 25% stabilizes, we'll ramp to 75%. if not, prepare controlled throttling (graceful 503s) to preserve system health.

sre-jamal: created temporary throttle policy: for acme-corp, route low-priority requests to 429 with Retry-After header = 10s. patch pushed:

```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/route/throttle -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp","policy":"low-priority-queue-evict","rate":0.6}'
```

eng-runtime-max: canary at 25% -> 75% now. monitoring CPU/GPU/KV cache.

incident-bot: autoscale manager: attempted to allocate 4 instances in us-west-2 — failed: InsufficientInstanceCapacity.

infra-kate: AWS rep says they can divert capacity from another AZ with 8-12m lag if we accept cross-AZ placement; risk: slightly higher network latency.

oncall-robin: risk/benefit: cross-AZ adds ~8-12ms p99 network overhead vs current p99 >>10s. I'd accept. do it.

infra-kate: kicking cross-AZ allocation now. should start add within ~9m.

sre-jamal: queue depth trending down after ramp to 75% canary and evictions. current waiting requests = 34 (was 220). 429s decreased by 60%.

vp-ops-lena: good. keep throttles in place until cross-AZ nodes join. prepare customer impact note: timeline + mitigations + ask for post-incident call. cs-amy can you draft?

cs-amy: drafting now, will include: what happened, our mitigations (eviction, canary downgrade, throttling, cross-AZ), ETA for full recovery, and offer of credits if SLA breached.

eng-runtime-max: once cross-AZ nodes join, we'll gradually shift traffic back to primary pool and remove throttles. plan for 15m warm-up to rebuild KV cache.

incident-bot: new instance registration detected at 1819000600: 4 nodes (p4d) joined dedicated-acme-01.

sre-jamal: now redistributing work. queue drained to <10. latency p95 back to baseline ~120ms.

oncall-robin: removing canary ramp to full for downgraded model? or rollback to original model?

eng-runtime-max: prefer to keep downgraded model for next 10m to avoid cache thrash, then test rollback on a canary. will run regen and compare.

vp-ops-lena: timeline and next steps look good. create incident ticket and RCA owners.

sre-jamal: ticket created: INC-2026-ACME-01. RCA owner = eng-runtime-max. infra action item = infra-kate for quota plan. oncall follow-up = oncall-robin.

cs-amy: sent mid-incident update to acme-corp (they acknowledged).

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated at 1819000750. impact: partial, degraded performance for 22m, no customer data egress.

oncall-robin: thanks team. keep monitoring for 2 hours. please document exact timeline and metrics in the ticket.

eng-runtime-max: will attach perf diffs, logs, and the model switch script used to RCA ticket.

infra-kate: will follow up with quota plan and request permanent buffer for dedicated pools used by enterprise tenants to avoid hitting account-level EC2 quotas.

vp-ops-lena: postmortem requested within 48h. include decision rationale for avoiding hosted fallback, and action to implement automated tenant fallback waiver workflow.

sre-jamal: adding note: recommend a safety headroom of at least 10% spare GPU capacity for dedicated pools and an automated quota-check before heavy rollouts.

oncall-robin: closing thread for active paging. will reopen if regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
